title_zh: Association of Brief Bouts of Vigorous Physical Activity and Frailty in Older Adults With Regular and Irregular Exercise Habits
title_en: Association of Brief Bouts of Vigorous Physical Activity and Frailty in Older Adults With Regular and Irregular Exercise Habits
journal_zh: Journal of Aging and Physical Activity, 2026
journal_en: Journal of Aging and Physical Activity, 2026
authors_zh: Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, Pei-Lin Tzeng, Chiung-Jung Wen, Ding-Cheng Chan
authors_en: Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, Pei-Lin Tzeng, Chiung-Jung Wen, Ding-Cheng Chan
abstract_zh: 運動一定要排出一整段時間才算數嗎？這篇研究關心短時間的高強度身體活動與衰弱的關係，並比較有、沒有規律運動習慣的長輩。（先別急著把沒時間當藉口，我們還是得看資料。）
abstract_en: Does physical activity have to come in one long session to count? This study looks at brief bouts of vigorous physical activity and frailty, comparing older adults with and without regular exercise habits. (Before reaching for the no-time excuse, let’s look at the data.)

title_zh: Timing of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity and mortality risk: role of chronotype and sleep patterns
title_en: Timing of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity and mortality risk: role of chronotype and sleep patterns
authors_zh: Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Yi-Chuan Hung, Myung-Jun Shin, Seunghwan Song, Up Huh, Hyuk Jin Choi, Jae-Il Lee, Yung Liao
authors_en: Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Yi-Chuan Hung, Myung-Jun Shin, Seunghwan Song, Up Huh, Hyuk Jin Choi, Jae-Il Lee, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 這是花了不少錢買資料庫做的，同樣是運動，早上動、晚上動，和健康的關係會不會不一樣？我們也把日夜型與睡眠型態一起納入分析，看看活動時間點與死亡風險的關聯。（研究做到後來，連幾點出門都變成研究問題。）
abstract_en: Access to the database for this one cost quite a bit. Does being active in the morning or evening have different associations with health? We considered chronotype and sleep patterns alongside the timing of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity and mortality risk. (Eventually, even the time you head out became a research question.)

title_zh: Effects of a virtual reality-based multimodal training program on cognitive and physical functions in community-dwelling adults aged 60 years and older: a randomized pre-post study
title_en: Effects of a virtual reality-based multimodal training program on cognitive and physical functions in community-dwelling adults aged 60 years and older: a randomized pre-post study
authors_zh: Du-Ri Kim, Myung-Jun Shin, Eun-Lee Lee, Ting-Fu Lai, Yeong-Ae Yang, Jong-Hwan Park
authors_en: Du-Ri Kim, Myung-Jun Shin, Eun-Lee Lee, Ting-Fu Lai, Yeong-Ae Yang, Jong-Hwan Park
abstract_zh: 這是在釜山做的研究，把虛擬實境放進訓練課程，除了看起來很有科技感，能不能對認知和身體功能有所幫助？這篇研究以社區 60 歲以上成人為對象，透過隨機分組與訓練前後測量，評估結合虛擬實境的多模式訓練效果。（設備很新是一回事，有沒有效還是得測量。）
abstract_en: This study was conducted in Busan. Virtual reality certainly makes a training program look high-tech, but can it help cognition and physical function? We used random assignment and measurements before and after training to evaluate a VR-based multimodal program for community-dwelling adults aged 60 and older. (New equipment is one thing. Whether it works still needs measuring.)

title_zh: A randomized controlled trial of wearable accelerometer-based feedback and behavior change techniques to increase physical activity and reduce sedentary behavior in older women
title_en: A randomized controlled trial of wearable accelerometer-based feedback and behavior change techniques to increase physical activity and reduce sedentary behavior in older women
authors_zh: Yu-Huei Wang, Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, I-Lun Cheng, Ming-Chun Hsueh
authors_en: Yu-Huei Wang, Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, I-Lun Cheng, Ming-Chun Hsueh
abstract_zh: 知道自己今天走了幾步，會不會真的讓人多走一點、少坐一點？我們透過 12 週隨機對照試驗，評估穿戴式加速規回饋搭配行為改變技巧，對高齡女性身體活動與久坐的影響。（買了裝置之後，還有真的開始動這個步驟。）
abstract_en: Does knowing today’s step count actually help someone move more and sit less? In a 12-week randomized controlled trial, we evaluated wearable accelerometer feedback combined with behavior change techniques among older women. (Buying the device still leaves the part where you actually start moving.)

title_zh: Improving Worker Health with Wearable Technology in a Power Plant
title_en: Improving Worker Health with Wearable Technology in a Power Plant
journal_zh: Journal of Occupational and Environmental Medicine, 2025
journal_en: Journal of Occupational and Environmental Medicine, 2025
authors_zh: Jong-Hwan Park, Ting-Fu Lai, Jeong Su Cho, Hyuk Jin Choi, Jae-Il Lee
authors_en: Jong-Hwan Park, Ting-Fu Lai, Jeong Su Cho, Hyuk Jin Choi, Jae-Il Lee
abstract_zh: 這是在釜山做的研究，穿戴式裝置進到職場，能不能幫忙照顧工作者的健康？這篇研究追蹤燃煤電廠工作者參與五個月健康管理方案前後的變化，觀察認知處理速度、呼吸功能、身體組成與體能表現。（電廠有設備要保養，裡面工作的人也應該被關注。）
abstract_en: This study was conducted in Busan. Can wearables help look after people’s health at work? We tracked changes in cognitive processing speed, respiratory function, body composition, and physical performance before and after a five-month health management program for coal-fired power plant workers. (The plant’s equipment gets maintenance. The people working there deserve attention too.)

title_zh: Longitudinal association of intensity-specific physical activity and sedentary behavior with dynapenia among older Taiwanese adults
title_en: Longitudinal association of intensity-specific physical activity and sedentary behavior with dynapenia among older Taiwanese adults
journal_zh: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity, 2025
journal_en: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity, 2025
authors_zh: Chih-Ching Chang, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
authors_en: Chih-Ching Chang, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 現在怎麼動、坐多久，和之後的肌力減退有什麼關係？我們追蹤臺灣高齡者，比較輕度、中高強度身體活動及靜態行為與後續力弱症的關聯。（以後再說在生活裡是很隨意的一句話，在研究裡就得真的追蹤到以後。）
abstract_en: How do today’s activity and sitting time relate to muscle weakness later on? We followed older adults in Taiwan to examine light activity, moderate-to-vigorous activity, and sedentary behavior in relation to subsequent dynapenia. (In everyday life, later can be a casual promise. In research, you actually have to follow up.)

title_zh: 高齡者使用商用行動裝置測量步數之效度
title_en: Validity of Step Count Measured by Commercial Mobile Devices Among Older Adults
authors_zh: 林翰柏, 陳佳人, 賴鼎富, 李姿愉, 廖邕
authors_en: Han-Bo Lin, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Tzu-Yu Li, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 手機說今天走了幾千步，這個數字到底準不準？我們以三軸加速規作為比較基準，檢驗商用行動裝置測量高齡者步數的準確性。（數字有顯示到個位數，看起來很精確；準不準是另一件事。）
abstract_en: Your phone says you walked several thousand steps today. How accurate is that number? We used a triaxial accelerometer as a reference to assess how well commercial mobile devices measure older adults’ steps. (A number displayed down to the last step looks precise. Whether it is accurate is another question.)

title_zh: Validation of Phase Angle Cutoff Values Derived From Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis for Sarcopenia Screening in Community-Dwelling Older Korean Adults
title_en: Validation of Phase Angle Cutoff Values Derived From Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis for Sarcopenia Screening in Community-Dwelling Older Korean Adults
authors_zh: Jiaren Chen, Jong-Hwan Park, Chien-Yu Lin, Ting-Fu Lai, et al.
authors_en: Jiaren Chen, Jong-Hwan Park, Chien-Yu Lin, Ting-Fu Lai, et al.
abstract_zh: 這是在釜山做的研究，身體組成檢測裡的相位角，能不能成為篩檢肌少症的線索？這篇研究以韓國社區高齡者為對象，檢驗生物電阻抗分析所得的相位角切點，評估它辨識肌少症的能力。（測量的成績單多一個數字很容易，要知道這個數字能做什麼，就得另外做研究。）
abstract_en: This study was conducted in Busan. Could phase angle, a measure from body composition testing, offer a clue for sarcopenia screening? We evaluated phase-angle cutoffs derived from bioelectrical impedance analysis in community-dwelling older Korean adults. (Adding a number to a results sheet is easy. Figuring out what it can do takes another study.)

title_zh: Light physical activity throughout the day and physical function in older adults: A cross-sectional study
title_en: Light physical activity throughout the day and physical function in older adults: A cross-sectional study
authors_zh: Ting-Fu Lai, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park
authors_en: Ting-Fu Lai, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park
abstract_zh: 同樣是輕度活動，發生在一天的不同時段，和身體功能的關係會不會不同？這篇橫斷面研究把活動依時段拆開，分析高齡者的日常活動分布與身體功能之間的關聯。（一天明明只有 24 小時，拆開分析後，工作量倒是增加不少。）
abstract_en: Does light activity at different times of day have different associations with physical function? This cross-sectional study examined the timing of older adults’ daily activity in relation to physical function. (A day still has only 24 hours. Splitting it up for analysis somehow creates more work.)

title_zh: Cross-sectional and longitudinal association between accelerometer-measured light-intensity physical activity and cognitive function in older adults
title_en: Cross-sectional and longitudinal association between accelerometer-measured light-intensity physical activity and cognitive function in older adults
authors_zh: Jing-Han Jhan, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
authors_en: Jing-Han Jhan, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 發表在知名水刊（刊登費都很貴），除了比較費力的運動，日常輕度活動也值得仔細看。我們用加速規測量活動，分析它與認知功能在同一時間點及後續追蹤中的關聯。（身體活動可以不用很激烈，資料分析的工作量倒是沒有跟著變輕。）
abstract_en: Published in what I jokingly call a soft-touch journal (with publication fees that are anything but soft). Everyday light activity deserves attention alongside more strenuous exercise. We used accelerometers to examine how light activity relates to cognitive function, both at the same time point and during follow-up. (The activity can be light. The analysis workload did not get the memo.)

title_zh: Dynapenia is associated with a higher risk of depressive symptoms among older adults
title_en: Dynapenia is associated with a higher risk of depressive symptoms among older adults
authors_zh: Chih-Ching Chang, Yung Liao, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Jong-Hwan Park, Yen-Jung Chang
authors_en: Chih-Ching Chang, Yung Liao, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Jong-Hwan Park, Yen-Jung Chang
abstract_zh: 發表在知名水刊（刊登費都很貴），肌力和心理健康，值得放在一起看。這篇研究分析高齡者力弱症與憂鬱症狀的關聯，關心身體功能下降時，是否也伴隨心理健康上的困難。談高齡健康時，身體和心情都需要被看見。
abstract_en: Published in what I jokingly call a soft-touch journal (with publication fees that are anything but soft). Muscle strength and mental health deserve to be considered together. This study examines the association between dynapenia and depressive symptoms in older adults, asking whether poorer physical function accompanies difficulties with mental health. Both physical and emotional well-being matter in healthy aging.

title_zh: Age Difference in the Association Between Nutritional Status and Dynapenia in Older Adults
title_en: Age Difference in the Association Between Nutritional Status and Dynapenia in Older Adults
authors_zh: Chih-Ching Chang, Ting-Fu Lai, Jiaren Chen, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park, Yen Jung Chang
authors_en: Chih-Ching Chang, Ting-Fu Lai, Jiaren Chen, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park, Yen Jung Chang
abstract_zh: 發表在知名水刊，營養狀況和肌力的關係，會不會隨年齡而不同？我們比較不同年齡層高齡者的營養狀況與力弱症關聯，看看把大家都歸在高齡者這一組時，可能漏掉哪些差異。（分組很方便，但人不會因為被分在同一組就變得一樣。）
abstract_en: Published in what I jokingly call a soft-touch journal. Does the relationship between nutritional status and muscle strength vary with age? We compared the association between nutritional status and dynapenia across age groups to see what we might miss by treating older adults as a single group. (Grouping people is convenient. It does not make everyone in the group the same.)

title_zh: Elevated extracellular water to total body water ratio and low phase angle in relation to muscle function in middle-aged and older adults
title_en: Elevated extracellular water to total body water ratio and low phase angle in relation to muscle function in middle-aged and older adults
journal_zh: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition, 2025
journal_en: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition, 2025
authors_zh: Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Minwoo Jang, Jiaren Chen, Myung-Jun Shin, Eunsoo Moon, Jung Mo Kang, Jong Won Lee, Yoon Jae Cho, Yung Liao, Tae Sik Goh, Jung Sub Lee
authors_en: Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Minwoo Jang, Jiaren Chen, Myung-Jun Shin, Eunsoo Moon, Jung Mo Kang, Jong Won Lee, Yoon Jae Cho, Yung Liao, Tae Sik Goh, Jung Sub Lee
abstract_zh: 做身體組成檢測，除了體脂肪，還有其他值得看的數字。我們分析中高齡者的細胞外水分占總水分比例，以及相位角與肌肉功能的關聯。（身體組成成績單上的縮寫很多，這篇先把其中兩個酷東西理解一下。）
abstract_en: There is more to a body composition test than body fat. We examined the extracellular-water-to-total-body-water ratio and phase angle in relation to muscle function in middle-aged and older adults. (Body composition reports have plenty of abbreviations. This paper gets to know two of the interesting ones.)

title_zh: Respiratory Function and Information Processing Speed in Coal Power Plant Workers: Moderating Effects of Physical Activity and Sedentary Behavior
title_en: Respiratory Function and Information Processing Speed in Coal Power Plant Workers: Moderating Effects of Physical Activity and Sedentary Behavior
authors_zh: Pill Soo Kim, Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Minwoo Jang, Yeo-Kyung Shin, Du-Ri Kim, Il Jae Wang, Hyuk Jin Choi, Jae-Il Lee
authors_en: Pill Soo Kim, Ting-Fu Lai, Jong-Hwan Park, Minwoo Jang, Yeo-Kyung Shin, Du-Ri Kim, Il Jae Wang, Hyuk Jin Choi, Jae-Il Lee
abstract_zh: 這是在釜山做的研究，呼吸功能與大腦處理資訊的速度有什麼關係？這篇以燃煤電廠工作者為對象，也把身體活動與久坐納入分析，看看兩者的關聯是否隨日常行為而不同。（研究問題只有一句，分析時還是得拆開慢慢看。）
abstract_en: This study was conducted in Busan. How does respiratory function relate to the speed of processing information? We studied coal-fired power plant workers and considered physical activity and sedentary behavior to see whether that relationship differed with everyday behavior. (The question fits into one sentence. The analysis still needs taking apart, step by step.)

title_zh: Older adults' Internet use behavior and its association with accelerometer-derived physical activity
title_en: Older adults' Internet use behavior and its association with accelerometer-derived physical activity
authors_zh: Yen-Yu Chung, Jiaren Chen, Mei-Chun Lin, Ruo-Lan Liu, Jenn-Bang Wu, Hsin Chang Tsai, Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park
authors_en: Yen-Yu Chung, Jiaren Chen, Mei-Chun Lin, Ruo-Lan Liu, Jenn-Bang Wu, Hsin Chang Tsai, Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park
abstract_zh: 發表在知名水刊（刊登費都很貴），長輩怎麼使用網路，和日常身體活動有什麼關係？我們把網路使用行為與加速規測得的活動資料放在一起分析，看看不同使用行為對應哪些活動模式。（先把上網就是坐著不動這個直覺放旁邊，讓資料說說看。）
abstract_en: Published in what I jokingly call a soft-touch journal (with publication fees that are anything but soft). How does older adults’ internet use relate to their daily physical activity? We combined internet-use behavior with accelerometer data to examine the activity patterns associated with different ways of using the internet. (Let’s set aside the assumption that going online means sitting still, and see what the data say.)

title_zh: 高齡者身體活動、靜態行為與相位角之範域文獻回顧
title_en: The Association between Physical Activity, Sedentary Behavior, and Phase Angle in Older Adults: A Scoping Review
authors_zh: 陳佳人, 賴鼎富, 林翰柏, 朴勝泰, 廖邕
authors_en: Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Han-Bo Lin, Seung-Tae Park, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 活動多一點、坐少一點，和身體組成檢測裡的相位角有什麼關係？這篇範域文獻回顧整理高齡者相關研究，盤點目前研究了什麼、知道多少，以及還有哪些地方不清楚。（研究做不完，至少先整理一下大家做到哪裡。）
abstract_en: How do physical activity and sedentary behavior relate to phase angle, a measure from body composition testing? This scoping review maps research in older adults: what has been studied, what is known, and what remains unclear. (There is no end to research. We can at least take stock of where everyone has got to.)

title_zh: Whole-Body and Segmental Phase Angles and Cognitive Function in the Older Korean Population: Cross-Sectional Analysis
title_en: Whole-Body and Segmental Phase Angles and Cognitive Function in the Older Korean Population: Cross-Sectional Analysis
authors_zh: Jiaren Chen, Jong-Hwan Park, Chien-Yu Lin, Ting-Fu Lai, Du-Ri Kim, Myung Jun Shin, Eunsoo Moon, Jung Mo Kang, Jong Won Lee, Yoon Jae Cho, Yung Liao, Tae Sik Goh, Jung Sub Lee
authors_en: Jiaren Chen, Jong-Hwan Park, Chien-Yu Lin, Ting-Fu Lai, Du-Ri Kim, Myung Jun Shin, Eunsoo Moon, Jung Mo Kang, Jong Won Lee, Yoon Jae Cho, Yung Liao, Tae Sik Goh, Jung Sub Lee
abstract_zh: 探討韓國高齡族群中，相位角與認知功能的關聯。
abstract_en: Examines associations between whole-body and segmental phase angles and cognitive function in older Korean adults.

title_zh: Sedentary Behavior and Phase Angle: An Objective Assessment in Physically Active and Inactive Older Adults
title_en: Sedentary Behavior and Phase Angle: An Objective Assessment in Physically Active and Inactive Older Adults
authors_zh: Liu-Yin Lin, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Yen-Yu Chung, Jong-Hwan Park, Yih-Jin Hu, Yung Liao
authors_en: Liu-Yin Lin, Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Yen-Yu Chung, Jong-Hwan Park, Yih-Jin Hu, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 比較了活躍與不活躍高齡者的靜態行為與相位角的關係。
abstract_en: Compares sedentary behavior and phase angle in physically active and inactive older adults.

title_zh: Associations between objectively measured overall and intensity-specific physical activity and phase angle in older adults
title_en: Associations between objectively measured overall and intensity-specific physical activity and phase angle in older adults
authors_zh: Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Chien-Yu Lin, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
authors_en: Jiaren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Chien-Yu Lin, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 整合客觀身體活動數據與臨床生物標記（相位角），探討兩者關係。
abstract_en: Integrates objective physical-activity data with phase angle as a clinical biomarker.

title_zh: Acute caffeine supplementation offsets the impairment in 10-km running performance following one night of partial sleep deprivation
title_en: Acute caffeine supplementation offsets the impairment in 10-km running performance following one night of partial sleep deprivation
authors_zh: Yi-Shan Tsai, Ting-Tzu Chen, Yau-Ching Chan, Chun-Chin Huang, Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, Richard S. Metcalfe, Yung-Chih Chen, Ho-Seng Wang
authors_en: Yi-Shan Tsai, Ting-Tzu Chen, Yau-Ching Chan, Chun-Chin Huang, Ting-Fu Lai, Yung Liao, Richard S. Metcalfe, Yung-Chih Chen, Ho-Seng Wang
abstract_zh: 驗證了咖啡因補充劑在部分睡眠剝奪後，對運動表現的恢復作用。
abstract_en: Tests whether caffeine supplementation attenuates performance loss after partial sleep deprivation.

title_zh: Association of 24-Hour movement behavior and cognitive function in older Taiwanese adults
title_en: Association of 24-Hour movement behavior and cognitive function in older Taiwanese adults
authors_zh: Ting-Fu Lai, Chih-Ching Chang, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Mohammad Javad Koohsari, Ai Shibata, Yung Liao, Koichiro Oka
authors_en: Ting-Fu Lai, Chih-Ching Chang, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Mohammad Javad Koohsari, Ai Shibata, Yung Liao, Koichiro Oka
abstract_zh: 全面分析 24 小時活動與睡眠、久坐行為與認知功能之關聯。
abstract_en: Analyzes 24-hour movement composition and cognitive function in older Taiwanese adults.

title_zh: Isotemporal Substitution Analysis of the Impact of Sedentary Behavior and Physical Activity on Depression in Taiwanese Older Adults: A Prospective Study
title_en: Isotemporal Substitution Analysis of the Impact of Sedentary Behavior and Physical Activity on Depression in Taiwanese Older Adults: A Prospective Study
authors_zh: Jia-Ren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Chien-Yu Lin, Li-Jung Lin, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
authors_en: Jia-Ren Chen, Ting-Fu Lai, Chien-Yu Lin, Li-Jung Lin, Jong-Hwan Park, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 探討以身體活動取代靜態行為對憂鬱症狀的影響。
abstract_en: Prospectively evaluates the impact of replacing sedentary behavior with physical activity on depressive symptoms.

title_zh: Effect of information and communication technology-based smart care services for physical and cognitive functions in older adults living alone: A quasi-experimental study
title_en: Effect of information and communication technology-based smart care services for physical and cognitive functions in older adults living alone: A quasi-experimental study
journal_zh: The Journal of Nutrition, Health & Aging, 2024
journal_en: The Journal of Nutrition, Health & Aging, 2024
authors_zh: Du-Ri Kim, Ting-Fu Lai, Minji Sung, Minwoo Jang, Yeo-Kyung Shin, Young Jin Ra, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park, Myung-Jun Shin
authors_en: Du-Ri Kim, Ting-Fu Lai, Minji Sung, Minwoo Jang, Yeo-Kyung Shin, Young Jin Ra, Yung Liao, Jong-Hwan Park, Myung-Jun Shin
abstract_zh: 評估 ICT 智慧照護服務對獨居高齡者的身心功能影響。
abstract_en: Evaluates ICT-based smart-care services for physical and cognitive function among older adults living alone.

title_zh: Park proximity and all-day and time-specific physical activity and sedentary behaviour in older adults
title_en: Park proximity and all-day and time-specific physical activity and sedentary behaviour in older adults
authors_zh: Chien-Yu Lin, Ting-Fu Lai, Chin-Yi Fang, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Yung Liao
authors_en: Chien-Yu Lin, Ting-Fu Lai, Chin-Yi Fang, Ming-Chun Hsueh, Yung Liao
abstract_zh: 探討公園鄰近性與高齡者全天及特定時段身體活動與靜態行為的關聯。
abstract_en: Examines whether proximity to parks is associated with all-day and time-specific physical activity and sedentary behaviour in older adults.
